                                               [--inventory INVENTORY]
                                               [--domain DOMAIN] [--out OUT]
                                               [--no-fail]

Audit Five-Element series coverage for the VLTK equipment system. Asserts
seed/catalog cover series 0..4, the three series tables are exported from
src/domain/equipment.ts, and every Hidden_Magic activation row in
ACTIVED_EQUIP_BY_SLOT is reachable. Writes data/vltk-normalized/equipment-
series-coverage.audit.json and exits non-zero on any gap.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --catalog CATALOG
  --inventory INVENTORY
  --domain DOMAIN
  --out OUT
  --no-fail             Always exit 0 even when coverage gaps are detected.

vltk-audit-equipment-visual-coverage.py.tail:
Audit preview-gated equipment visual manifest coverage and walk a small set of
sample equipped loadouts (seed + synthesized) to verify every required sample
has either a passed-generated manifest entry or a complete layered-parts
fallback.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --catalog CATALOG
  --inventory INVENTORY
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --parts-manifest PARTS_MANIFEST
  --out OUT
  --require-complete    Fail when the historical visual-combination count is
                        below the theoretical maximum.
  --require-pass        Fail when any required sample loadout has neither a
                        passed-generated manifest entry nor a complete
                        layered-parts fallback. Default: True.
  --no-require-pass     Disable the required-sample gate (still emits the
                        audit JSON).
